name: ThinkPad T14 Gen 3
summary: Modular 14-inch enterprise business laptop with bottom-cover access, socketed RAM, M.2 SSD, removable battery, and heatsink blower assembly.

sources.title: Lenovo ThinkPad T14 Gen 3 Product Specifications Reference & Hardware Maintenance Manual
iFixit Lenovo ThinkPad T14 Gen 3 Disassembly & Battery Replacement Guide
LaptopMedia Inside Lenovo ThinkPad T14 Gen 3: Disassembly and Upgrade Options

verification.notes: Draft laptop definition based on Lenovo HMM, iFixit teardown, and LaptopMedia laboratory analysis.

components.name: Bottom cover
components.fastening: Seven captive Phillips #00 screws and perimeter clips around the chassis edges.

info.what: The matte black magnesium-aluminum bottom enclosure plate of the laptop.
info.does: Encloses and shields internal electronics, features intake vents for the cooling fan, and secures with captive screws.
info.ifFails: Exposes sensitive motherboard circuits to foreign object debris, dust buildup, and structural flex.

onMissing.symptom: Bottom cover removed: internal electronics exposed to dust and short circuits.

components.name: Battery (52.5 Wh)
components.fastening: Three Phillips #00 screws securing the battery tabs to the palm rest frame, and a pull-out connector harness to the motherboard.

info.what: A 3-cell 52.5 watt-hour lithium-ion rechargeable battery pack.
info.does: Supplies system DC power to the motherboard power management circuitry and subsystem rails.
info.ifFails: Device fails to power on without AC power, shuts down abruptly under heavy load, or experiences thermal runaway if swollen.

onMissing.symptom: No battery installed: laptop has no energy source and cannot power on.

onDamaged.symptom: Damaged battery pack: severe voltage sag under processor workload triggers emergency shutdown.

onIncompatible.symptom: Incompatible battery pack: power management controller cannot negotiate cell parameters.

components.name: M.2 NVMe SSD (2280)
components.fastening: One Phillips #00 screw securing the copper heatsink bracket and M.2 standoff.

info.what: PCIe 4.0 x4 M.2 2280 NVMe solid state drive with dedicated thermal shield.
info.does: Stores the operating system, bootloader partitions, applications, and persistent user files.
info.ifFails: Laptop fails to boot past UEFI POST, showing '2100: Detection error on Storage Device'.

onMissing.symptom: No boot device detected: 2100 Storage device missing from M.2 slot.

onDamaged.symptom: Storage device read failure: corrupt boot partition prevents operating system boot.

onIncompatible.symptom: Unrecognised storage device format: system cannot initialize non-NVMe media.

components.name: DDR SO-DIMM RAM
components.fastening: Metal EMI shield cover and dual side spring retention clips.

info.what: Socketed DDR SO-DIMM memory expansion module under a protective metal shield.
info.does: Expands high-speed system memory for the operating system and running processes.
info.ifFails: Severe performance degradation or memory training failure on boot.

onMissing.symptom: SO-DIMM slot empty: operating system constrained to slower single-channel soldered memory.

onDamaged.symptom: Memory integrity test failed: defective RAM causes kernel panics and POST lockup.

components.name: Cooling Fan & Heatsink
components.fastening: Four captive spring-tensioned Phillips #00 screws on the CPU heatsink plate, plus a 4-pin PWM wire connector.

info.what: Centrifugal blower fan and copper heat pipe assembly over the CPU die.
info.does: Draws thermal energy away from the processor via vapor chamber heat pipes and exhausts hot air out the chassis side.
info.ifFails: Thermal throttling occurs immediately under load, followed by thermal emergency shutdown.

onMissing.symptom: Cooling assembly missing: CPU heats to critical limit within 15 seconds.

onDamaged.symptom: Cooling fan seized: bearings rattle and air cannot circulate through clogged heatsink fins.

components.name: Motherboard
components.fastening: Five Phillips #00 screws securing the PCB to the upper palm rest frame, and flexible display/trackpad ribbon cables.

info.what: The main motherboard housing the Intel Core processor, soldered memory, Thunderbolt controllers, and power circuitry.
info.does: Interconnects all system buses, regulates voltage rails, and executes firmware and computation.
info.ifFails: Total power failure, inability to post, or failure of external Thunderbolt and USB ports.

onMissing.symptom: Motherboard missing: system has no processor or power regulation circuitry.

onDamaged.symptom: Motherboard circuit fault: shorted VRM prevents power rails from energizing.

components.name: Keyboard & Top Chassis
components.fastening: Integrated into the magnesium top chassis palm rest structure beneath the system board.

info.what: ThinkPad backlit ergonomic keyboard module with TrackPoint pointing stick and dedicated mouse buttons.
info.does: Captures user keystrokes and cursor inputs, routing scan matrices to the EC (Embedded Controller).
info.ifFails: Keys fail to register, stuck inputs cause boot beeps, or liquid spill damages matrix traces.

onMissing.symptom: Keyboard assembly missing: cannot enter text or navigate without external USB keyboard.

onDamaged.symptom: Keyboard matrix fault: multiple key rows fail to register.

components.name: 14-inch IPS Display
components.fastening: Four heavy-duty hinge screws securing steel display brackets to the base chassis.

info.what: 14.0-inch 16:10 WUXGA (1920x1200) anti-glare IPS display panel and lid assembly.
info.does: Renders operating system graphic output, BIOS prompts, and multimedia interfaces with LED backlighting.
info.ifFails: Black screen, cracked matrix with liquid crystal bleed, or flickering eDP cable signal.

onMissing.symptom: Display assembly missing: no internal screen output (external monitor required).

onDamaged.symptom: Display panel damaged: cracked glass and distorted LCD lines.

spares.name: Clogged Thermal Fan (Faulty)
spares.condition: Bearing jammed with dust and lint

cases.title: Swollen Cell Syndrome
cases.brief: The ThinkPad shuts down abruptly whenever unplugged from AC power and the bottom panel shows slight bulging.
symptoms: Severe battery degradation: laptop powers off under moderate CPU load.
Bottom cover exhibits outward pressure near the battery bay.
cases.explanation: The internal lithium-ion battery cells had degraded and developed internal resistance, causing emergency shutdowns under system load. Swapping in a healthy OEM battery restored full runtime and stable DC rails.

cases.title: Storage Detection Failure
cases.brief: During boot, the laptop halts with error '2100: Detection error on Storage Device (M.2 NVMe SSD)'.
symptoms: Operating system cannot load because the NVMe controller is unresponsive.
cases.explanation: The primary M.2 2280 SSD suffered NAND controller failure, preventing BIOS enumeration. Installing a fresh NVMe SSD under the thermal bracket restored boot capability.

cases.title: Thermal Exhaust Blockage
cases.brief: The laptop fan whines at maximum RPM and the machine forcibly shuts down after 30 seconds of workload.
symptoms: CPU temperature exceeds 95 °C triggering thermal shutdown.
Fan generates abnormal grinding noise without exhausting airflow.
cases.explanation: Lint and hardened debris seized the centrifugal fan impeller, preventing heat pipe dissipation. Replacing the heatsink blower unit restored nominal operating temperatures under test load.
